ig001.name: Circular arrow loops
ig001.use_when: A loop with no text inside (flywheel, recurring revenue, recycling); label the stages beside it
ig001.dont_use_when: Stages that need text inside the shapes (use ig002 v3 or the cycles 20-28)

ig002.name: Four-arrow operating loop
ig002.use_when: A 4-stage repeating loop with a one-word label inside each arrow (plan, analyse, control, track)
ig002.dont_use_when: Stages that need a sentence each; more or fewer than 4 stages (v1/v2/v4 are small text-free loops)

ig003.name: Curved arrow shapes
ig003.use_when: Icon / arrow shapes to copy into another layout
ig003.dont_use_when: As a slide layout on its own

ig004.name: Square arrows: converge, diverge, loop
ig004.use_when: Four forces pushing in (converge) or out (diverge), a square 4-step loop, or a short 3-chevron flow
ig004.dont_use_when: Steps that need text inside (use chevrons or ig101-107)

ig005.name: 2x2 notched quadrant / merging streams
ig005.use_when: Four text blocks in a 2x2 (strengths / weaknesses style), or two streams merging into one (a merger)
ig005.dont_use_when: Long text per quadrant; a real 2x2 with axes (use harvey or a table)

ig006.name: Chevron-topped columns
ig006.use_when: 5-6 parallel workstreams or pillars, each a title plus 3 bullets; or a risks vs opportunities two-panel
ig006.dont_use_when: A sequence where order matters (use chevrons)

ig007.name: Clock: four-step cycle
ig007.use_when: A 4-step quarterly or annual cycle (budget, review, report...), each step with a heading and 2-line text
ig007.dont_use_when: Steps not tied to a calendar; more than 4 steps

ig008.name: Four inputs to one outcome
ig008.use_when: Four numbered drivers (heading + 2-line text) feeding one central result
ig008.dont_use_when: Drivers with no shared outcome (use stat_icons)

ig009.name: Venn diagrams (2-4 circles)
ig009.use_when: Overlap, strategic fit or synergies between 2-4 businesses or capabilities
ig009.dont_use_when: Parts that do not overlap (use pie sections or pill_rows)

ig010.name: Four-ellipse Venn with % values
ig010.use_when: Overlap shares between 4 customer groups or products, % in each region

ig011.name: Concentric rings and quadrant discs
ig011.use_when: Core-to-periphery layers (core business, adjacencies, new markets) or 4 equal quadrants; label beside
ig011.dont_use_when: Real proportions (use stat_rings or a chart)

ig012.name: Pie sections (2-12 equal slices)
ig012.use_when: A numbered split into 2-12 equal parts with labels beside (segments, product lines)
ig012.dont_use_when: Real proportions (use stacked or stat_rings); the pies are one group, so delete the counts you don't need

ig013.name: 16-part wheel with outer ring
ig013.use_when: 12-16 parts around a core (a portfolio of assets, a product range) with short labels in the segments
ig013.dont_use_when: Fewer than 8 parts (use ig015 or ig019)

ig014.name: Phase wheels (3-7 segments)
ig014.use_when: 3-7 components or phases around a central title, 1-3 words per segment
ig014.dont_use_when: Segments that need sentences (use ig019 or ig036)

ig015.name: Five-section wheel with centre
ig015.use_when: Five business pillars or segments around a centre theme, one short line in each segment (v3)
ig015.dont_use_when: Numbers per segment (use ig019 with numbered bubbles); v1-v7 are text-free 2-8 part rings

ig016.name: Sectioned rings with arrows
ig016.use_when: A continuous loop of 2-6 stages; text-free, label the stages beside it

ig017.name: Five-part arrow wheel and pinwheel
ig017.use_when: A 5-step value cycle with 1-2 words per segment, or 4 quadrants with ring labels

ig018.name: Numbered seven-part wheel
ig018.use_when: Up to 7 numbered parts around a wheel, explained in a list beside it

ig019.name: Five pillars around a goal
ig019.use_when: Five numbered strategic pillars around a central goal, one line of text in each segment
ig019.dont_use_when: Pillars needing more than ~8 words (use side_tabs)

ig020.name: Three-part ring around a globe
ig020.use_when: A global 3-stage loop (source, make, distribute) with labels on the ring

ig021.name: Three arrows around a globe; progress rings
ig021.use_when: A global loop of 3 stages (v2); progress rings 1/6 to 6/6 (v1) for completion status

ig022.name: Core radiating into four segments
ig022.use_when: One core offering serving 4 markets or segments, labels on the ring (v3)

ig023.name: Three-part ring with globe; progress donuts
ig023.use_when: A 3-way global split around a globe (v3)

ig024.name: Circular icon layouts
ig024.use_when: Icon / arrow shapes to copy into another layout
ig024.dont_use_when: As a slide layout on its own

ig025.name: Six-segment wheel; entry into a loop
ig025.use_when: A 6-part wheel with labels on the segments (v1), or an entry arrow feeding a recurring loop (v2)

ig026.name: M&A deal cycle
ig026.use_when: The deal lifecycle: strategy, due diligence, financing, execution, post-deal integration (v2); a 4-arc loop (v1)
ig026.dont_use_when: A deal timetable with dates (use timeline)

ig027.name: Entry arrow into a four-step cycle
ig027.use_when: Capital entering a repeating cycle (invest, grow, harvest, reinvest), short labels

ig028.name: Twelve-step lifecycle with text blocks
ig028.use_when: A detailed 8-12 step lifecycle with a header and text block per step (dense one-page process)

ig029.name: Hubs with radiating arms
ig029.use_when: A centre splitting into 3-4 outputs or channels, short labels on each arm

ig030.name: Three stakeholders around a shared centre
ig030.use_when: Three parties or values converging on one shared centre (company, employer, assignees; values triangle)

ig031.name: Target operating model
ig031.use_when: Operating model: functions across the top, geographies below, the target model in the centre
ig031.dont_use_when: Simple org charts (use ig071-073 pyramids or a table)

ig032.name: Core with three satellites; quadrant disc
ig032.use_when: A core with 3 linked satellites (v2) or 4 quadrants with ring labels (v1)

ig033.name: Quadrants with circular arrows; spiral
ig033.use_when: Four stages of a loop set in quadrants, short labels

ig034.name: Quadrant background with central loop
ig034.use_when: Four corner labels around a 4-part central loop

ig035.name: Quadrant pie in arrows; 12-part wheel
ig035.use_when: Four quadrants inside a loop of arrows (v1) or a 12-part wheel with ring text (v2)

ig036.name: Interlocking numbered pillars with icons
ig036.use_when: 3 (v1) or 4 (v2) numbered pillars, each with icon, heading and 2-line text, around a central heading

ig037.name: Four numbered bubbles around a hub
ig037.use_when: 4 numbered themes, each a title plus ~25 words, of unequal weight (bubble sizes differ)

ig038.name: Layered target wheel; nested rings with arrows
ig038.use_when: Layers from core to edge, 4 quadrants x 3 rings with short labels (v1), or nested rings around a two-way flow (v2)

ig039.name: Four-section ring with bullet corners
ig039.use_when: Four sections around a centre, each with a title on the ring and 4 bullets in its corner

ig040.name: Four-quadrant ring with corner text
ig040.use_when: Four themes on a ring with a short phrase each and a longer note in each corner

ig041.name: Arrow wheel with icons; four numbered dials
ig041.use_when: 6 steps with icon, heading and short text around a wheel plus a heading/paragraph (v1); 4 numbered steps as dials (v2)

ig042.name: Six-section wheel with bullet panels
ig042.use_when: 6 sections on a wheel, each with a title, and bullet panels left and right explaining them

ig043.name: Six pillars of success with risk text
ig043.use_when: 6 pillars around a goal, each with a 4-5 bullet text block (risk areas, success factors)

ig044.name: Seven and six-part ringed wheels
ig044.use_when: 6 (v2) or 7 (v1) labelled segments around a numbered or titled centre

ig045.name: Seven petals with icons
ig045.use_when: 7 offerings or values around a central heading, each with icon, title and ~20 words

ig046.name: Eight and nine-petal star wheels
ig046.use_when: 8-9 numbered parts around a centre, one word each

ig047.name: Nested ring cycles
ig047.use_when: A loop of 3-4 stages inside an outer ring of themes, short labels on the ring

ig048.name: Three-level sunburst
ig048.use_when: A 3-level breakdown (group, division, product) as a sunburst with short labels

ig049.name: Ring of 12 labelled points; ringed 12-part wheel
ig049.use_when: 12 short items around a centre (months, product lines, process points), one or two words each

ig050.name: Eight-spoke star; arrows around a core
ig050.use_when: 8 short items radiating from a numbered core (v1), or 4-5 arrows circling a core value (v2)

ig051.name: Team wheel (core team and partners)
ig051.use_when: A deal or advisory team: core team in the centre, names and titles around, senior partners on the arcs
ig051.dont_use_when: Org charts with reporting lines (use ig071-073 or a table)

ig052.name: Main heading with six bubbles and side text
ig052.use_when: 6-8 themes around a main heading, each with a short heading on the bubble and ~30 words of text outside

ig053.name: Eight-node flower around a title
ig053.use_when: 8 short items around one title (product lines, markets)

ig054.name: One central solution with 10 bands
ig054.use_when: One platform serving 8-10 named services or modules, listed in bands left and right

ig055.name: Concentric bubbles of client value
ig055.use_when: A value proposition: a core statement, inner ring of 6-8 strengths, outer ring of 6-8 outcomes, 2-4 words each

ig056.name: Labelled sunburst around a core
ig056.use_when: A capability or risk universe: 12-16 labelled segments around a core function (e.g. IT assurance, internal audit)

ig057.name: Speedometer gauges (%)
ig057.use_when: 1-3 percentage scores shown as gauges (utilisation, occupancy, margin vs target)

ig058.name: Large speedometer with average
ig058.use_when: One headline score on a 0-100 scale with an average (customer score, utilisation)

ig059.name: Radial heat map
ig059.use_when: Scores for 6-8 areas on a radial scale (maturity or risk assessment by area)

ig060.name: Circular bar chart (target vs current)
ig060.use_when: Target vs current scores across 10-20 areas in one compact radial chart

ig061.name: Four-quadrant stacked ring of % bars
ig061.use_when: 4 categories, each with up to 10 stacked % rings (survey results by region or segment)

ig062.name: Alphabet wheel with % markers
ig062.use_when: A share split across up to 26 small categories with % markers around the rim

ig063.name: Three donuts with % segments
ig063.use_when: Mix by category for 3 entities or years (revenue mix, cost mix), with a shared legend

ig064.name: Three % rings with captions
ig064.use_when: 3 headline percentages, each with a one-line caption (survey answers, adoption rates)
ig064.dont_use_when: Numbers that are not shares of a whole

ig065.name: Arc bars by country (3 questions)
ig065.use_when: Survey or market results: 3 questions x 4 countries as arcs with % values

ig066.name: Spiral ranking of scores
ig066.use_when: A ranked list of 6-9 items with scores, drawn as concentric arcs
ig066.dont_use_when: Values that need precise reading (use bar)

ig067.name: Year-on-year spiral arcs
ig067.use_when: Two years compared as concentric arcs (2011 vs 2012)

ig068.name: Odds bubbles (risk ratios)
ig068.use_when: Likelihood ratios for 2-3 scenarios shown as bubbles on a line

ig069.name: Radar screen (positioning arcs)
ig069.use_when: Positioning 3-6 players or opportunities on a semicircle by segment and distance from the centre (priority)

ig070.name: Hub of measure bars by risk area
ig070.use_when: Scores for 10-16 areas grouped into 3-4 themes around an identify/measure/manage/monitor hub

ig071.name: Pyramids (3-4 levels)
ig071.use_when: 3-4 tiers from base to top (customer tiers, capital structure, Maslow-style priorities), short label per tier

ig072.name: Governance pyramid with notes
ig072.use_when: A 5-tier pyramid (intent, goals, strategy, plans, results) with a note per tier and KPI brackets

ig073.name: Value pyramid (protection to enhancement)
ig073.use_when: Value creation levers in tiers: value protection at the base, enhancement at the top, 3-6 boxes per tier

ig074.name: Hexagon pillars, tabs, honeycomb, network
ig074.use_when: Three-sided strengths around a hexagon (v1), 4 stacked numbered tabs (v2), a honeycomb cluster (v3), or a network of 6 nodes around a hub (v4)

ig075.name: Six hexagon columns with icons
ig075.use_when: 6 numbered pillars, each with icon, heading and ~20 words (capabilities, strengths)

ig076.name: Honeycomb with section text
ig076.use_when: 6 sections on a honeycomb around a centre, each with a title and ~25 words beside

ig077.name: Six arrows converging on a hexagon
ig077.use_when: 6 drivers or market forces pushing in on one point, short label on each arrow

ig078.name: Octagon clusters
ig078.use_when: 2-3 linked units each with 8 surrounding parts; text-free, labels beside

ig079.name: Spider diagram with points
ig079.use_when: Plotting 2-4 items on 8 axes (positioning, capability scores)

ig080.name: Radar overlay diagram
ig080.use_when: Comparing 2-3 profiles across 6-8 criteria as overlapping shapes (us vs peers)
ig080.dont_use_when: Exact values (use harvey or a table)

ig081.name: Jigsaw grid
ig081.use_when: Pieces that fit together (bolt-on acquisitions completing a platform); text-free, colour the key pieces

ig082.name: Large jigsaw panel
ig082.use_when: Large 2x5 jigsaw for a 'missing piece' story, one piece highlighted

ig083.name: Jigsaw ring; jigsaw column
ig083.use_when: A ring of 8 interlocking pieces around a core (v2) or 4 stacked pieces (v1); text-free

ig084.name: Loose and locked jigsaw pieces
ig084.use_when: Fit between businesses: loose pieces vs a completed square (strategic fit, merger)

ig085.name: Three-column jigsaw (process, brand, ROI)
ig085.use_when: 3 workstreams as jigsaw columns with short labels on the pieces

ig086.name: Two-by-three large jigsaw
ig086.use_when: A 6-piece 'missing piece' visual, text-free (complete the platform)

ig087.name: Jigsaw pattern texture
ig087.use_when: Background texture for a cover or divider
ig087.dont_use_when: As a slide layout on its own

ig088.name: Eight-piece jigsaw wheel
ig088.use_when: 8 numbered parts of one whole (e.g. an integrated offering), each with ~20 words, around a centre title

ig089.name: Chain of cog wheels
ig089.use_when: 6-10 interlocking steps or functions that drive each other, 1-2 words in each cog

ig090.name: Two interlocking cogs
ig090.use_when: Two businesses or functions working together (synergy), labels beside

ig091.name: Cogs in a conveyor loop
ig091.use_when: Two engines driving a continuous loop (operating model, flywheel); text-free

ig092.name: Two cogs with icons and options
ig092.use_when: Two capability engines (4 icons each) with option notes beside

ig093.name: Bridge / waterfall chart
ig093.use_when: Walk from a start value to an end value through 3-6 drivers (EBITDA bridge, value creation bridge)
ig093.dont_use_when: Use only when python charts are unavailable; prefer fin_chart / native waterfall

ig094.name: Thermometer (progress to target)
ig094.use_when: One measure rising between two years or toward a target (fundraising progress)

ig095.name: Percentage columns with bubbles
ig095.use_when: 3-5 categories with a headline % each, drawn as filled columns (utilisation, margin by segment)

ig096.name: Four thermometer bars with icons
ig096.use_when: 4 numbered measures with a level marker and a short caption each

ig097.name: Dot plot with value labels
ig097.use_when: 8-10 values over time or categories as labelled dots
ig097.dont_use_when: Prefer fin_chart line; use only for a stylised look

ig098.name: Bottleneck funnel over time
ig098.use_when: A shift over time from one model to another (local to shared services), with 4-6 short labels

ig099.name: Five icon blocks feeding one output
ig099.use_when: 5 inputs (icon + ~25 words each) combining into one outcome line

ig100.name: Maze (complexity to clarity)
ig100.use_when: A complex path we navigate for the client (regulatory approvals, deal complexity); text-free

ig101.name: Three streams into one big arrow
ig101.use_when: 3 inputs merging into one outcome with 3 bullets (how 3 sources combine into the thesis)

ig102.name: Bull and bear two-way arrows
ig102.use_when: Upside vs downside case (bull vs bear), each with heading and ~25 words

ig103.name: Nested chevron of six layers
ig103.use_when: 6 stacked layers ending in one point (6 drivers building to one result), short label each

ig104.name: Three numbered branches into blocks
ig104.use_when: 3 numbered streams branching into 3 stacked blocks with text (fund flows, workstreams)

ig105.name: Diagonal numbered steps; icon list
ig105.use_when: 4 numbered steps with ~15 words each on a diagonal band (v1) or 4 icon rows with numbered bubbles (v2)

ig106.name: Four steps with icons and text
ig106.use_when: 4 sequential steps, each with icon, step name and ~30 words to the right (deal process, value plan)

ig107.name: Funnel of inputs to one output
ig107.use_when: Many inputs narrowing into one output (deal screening: universe to shortlist), short labels
ig107.dont_use_when: Exact numbers per stage (use ig127 or a table)

ig108.name: Numbered options with speech panels
ig108.use_when: 4 numbered options, each with ~40 words in a panel (strategic options, exit routes)

ig109.name: House with roots (foundations)
ig109.use_when: One roof message supported by 6-8 foundation items (platform built on capabilities)

ig110.name: Five chevrons with notes above and below
ig110.use_when: 5 sequential phases with a title in each chevron and ~15 words alternating above and below

ig111.name: Numbered milestone rows
ig111.use_when: 5 milestones with ~20 words each (v1) or 7 numbered steps with one line each (v2)

ig112.name: 1-5 rating scales
ig112.use_when: Rating 3-5 items on a 1-5 scale (maturity, risk score) or strong/average/weak dots (v3)

ig113.name: Branching process (protect vs enhance)

ig114.name: Three-step spiral with tasks

ig115.name: Converging and diverging arrows

ig116.name: Inputs-funnel-outputs

ig117.name: Monopoly board timeline

ig118.name: Phase chevron rows

ig119.name: Five option columns with icons

ig120.name: Three workstreams x three steps

page_market.name: Market page: framing strip over three exhibits
page_market.use_when: A market argument: cause on the left, constraint on the right, then 3 exhibits (chart, bar, evidence table)
page_market.dont_use_when: Fewer than 3 pieces of evidence (use page_overview)
page_market.call: framing strip (2 boxes + arrow) at top; d.column / d.bar / d.table below, each under a header bar + takeaway

page_overview.name: Overview page: photo, fact strip, chart and commentary
page_overview.use_when: An asset or market overview: photo with bullets, 5 key numbers across the top, a ranked bar and commentary
page_overview.dont_use_when: No real photo of the asset (use page_market)
page_overview.call: d.photo left + bullets; d.stat_icons across the top right; d.bar + commentary bullets below

page_geography.name: Geography page: labelled map beside a comparison table
page_geography.use_when: Comparing 2-4 places (sites, countries, cities): map with pins and labels beside a metric table + commentary
page_geography.dont_use_when: A single location; more than ~5 places (use a table)
page_geography.call: d.photo(map) + pins left; d.table and commentary bullets right

page_landscape.name: Landscape page: logo wall by segment beside a chart
page_landscape.use_when: Competitive landscape or buyer universe: logos grouped into 3 segments, a scale bar chart beside it
page_landscape.call: d.logo_row per segment column (outline=False); d.bar right with bullets below

page_deals.name: Deal page: full-width table, chart and takeaways
page_deals.use_when: Precedent transactions or comps: full-width table, a bar of the implied multiple and takeaways
page_deals.dont_use_when: Fewer than 4 deals (use a table on a mixed page)
page_deals.call: d.table full width; d.bar + takeaway bullets below

page_text.name: Text page: framing box, two-level bullets, number strip
page_text.use_when: Executive summary or recommendation: dashed framing sentence, two columns of two-level bullets, 4-6 numbers
page_text.dont_use_when: Content that can be shown as a chart or diagram
page_text.call: d.takeaway framing box; two header bars + two-level bullets; d.stat_strip at the bottom

page_risks.name: Risks page: risk matrix beside strengths and watch-points
page_risks.use_when: Risk section: 3-5 risks with mitigants and severity, strengths vs watch-points on the right

page_thesis.name: Thesis page: side tabs beside pill rows
page_thesis.use_when: Investment thesis: 3-5 argued pillars with a supporting overview panel
